description: CoreQuartz presents Terra-Analog, an advanced, web-based Mission Control dashboard designed to bridge Earth-based geological analog sites with future human exploration targets on Mars, the Moon, and Icy Ocean Worlds. Built for international compliance and technical fidelity, our platform provides researchers and mission planners with real-time telemetry, spatial comparison tools, and scientific validation for 10 core planetary analog sectors worldwide.
summary:
Hello, we are Team CoreQuartz. Finding the most accurate terrestrial sites on Earth to test astronauts and spacecraft prior to Lunar and Martian missions is a major cost and time challenge.

To address this, we developed TERRA-ANALOG, an interactive web platform that utilizes NASA’s open datasets to match extreme environments on Earth—from Lake Salda to the Atacama Desert—with Jezero Crater and future Lunar bases. Powered by our smart simulator, the platform evaluates environmental parameters such as temperature, aridity, and soil composition to calculate the most ideal analog test site in seconds.

TERRA-ANALOG is important because it accelerates Earth-based mission readiness, significantly reduces testing costs, and guides data-driven planning for sustainable human habitats beyond Earth
details:
TERRA-ANALOG is an advanced interactive web platform designed to solve a major bottleneck in space exploration: finding the most accurate terrestrial analog sites on Earth to test astronauts, rovers, and life-support systems before launching them into Lunar and Martian missions. By leveraging NASA’s open datasets, our application maps and cross-references extreme environments on Earth—such as Lake Salda, the Atacama Desert, and hyper-arid volcanic regions—with extraterrestrial targets like Jezero Crater and prospective Lunar base locations.

Core Features & Smart Simulator Powered by our custom-built smart matching simulator, TERRA-ANALOG evaluates critical environmental parameters in real time. Users can filter and compare regions based on temperature extremes, aridity indexes, terrain topography, and soil composition. The system calculates a similarity score to determine the most ideal Earth-based test center for specific mission requirements within seconds.

Tools, Technologies & Software To build this project, our team utilized modern web development frameworks for the frontend interface and geospatial mapping libraries to handle multi-layered NASA datasets, elevation models, and coordinate transformations dynamically.

Creativity, Impact & Considerations What makes TERRA-ANALOG unique is its data-driven approach to bridging the gap between theoretical space mission planning and practical, Earth-based testing. Testing equipment and training crews directly in space carries immense financial and operational risks. By providing an accessible, precise tool to identify the closest Earth analogs, our project significantly accelerates mission readiness, reduces research costs, and paves the way for sustainable human habitation beyond Earth.
